test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following persons was NOT amongst the female judges sworn in as judges of the Supreme Court of India on 31st August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Indira Banerjee.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Justice Indira Banerjee ****was not amongst the** **female judges sworn in as judges of the Supreme Court of India on 31****st August 2021.**
 
• **Nine new judges, including three women, **whose appointments to the Supreme Court have been cleared by the Centre, **were sworn in on August 31 by Chief Justice of India (CJI) N V Ramana.**
 
• The women judges who have been appointed to the apex court:
 
 
• **Justice BV Nagarathna, the third senior-most judge of the Karnataka High Court.**
 
• **Justice Hima Kohli, the Chief Justice of the Telangana High Court.**
 
• **Justice Bela M Trivedi, the fifth senior-most judge of the Gujarat High Court.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice Indira Banerjee.**

 
 
• **​She was appointed as Judge of the Supreme Court of India on 7 August 2018.**
 
• **Indira Banerjee is the 8th female Judge in the history of the Supreme Court of India.**
 
• She is the** former Chief Justice of Madras High Court, the second woman to hold the position in India** before being elevated as a Judge of the Supreme Court of India.
